Agility.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Arc.definition: Narrative sequence — a bounded structural unit within the emergent campaign framework. Arcs are designed in batches (arcs_01-04, arcs_05-09, etc.) and tracked in arcs/. See `arcs/arc_expansion_v30.md`.

Artificial Intelligence.definition: Behaviour-tree decision logic for NPC-controlled factions/characters. See `systems/npcs/npc_behavior_v30.md`.

Attunement.definition: Sensitivity to people, environments, and Thread-adjacent phenomena.
Attunement.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Belief.definition: Player-authored character conviction. Mechanical driver for Momentum and Character Points. Distinct from Inspiration (see below).

Board Game.definition: **Exception — abbreviation permitted standalone.** Strategic layer of the Valoria videogame.
Board Game.glossary_part: PART TEN — GAME MODE LABELS (videogame mechanical layers)

Burning Wheel.definition: Precedent game (Burning Wheel by Luke Crane). Referenced in cognitive load / precedent analysis. **Design-precedent term**; not an in-game mechanic.

CI.definition: **Do not use CI.** Write `CI` for Church Influence; `Piety Track` (or `CT` in technical contexts) for the debate tracker.

CI Political.definition: Church Influence political dynamics — milestones, seizure mechanics, Theocracy Unification spec. Renamed from `tc_political_redesign_v30` (same doc, CI = Church Influence's politically-active form per `references/canonical_sources.yaml` note).

CP.definition: CP = Character Points only [ED-136]. Use "Power" for the unit offensive stat.

Campaign Architecture.definition: Architectural specification for campaign-scale structure: phase ordering, season cadence, scale-transition orchestration.

Cardinal.definition: Title for a senior Church official with Great Influence in the Church of Solmund. Four-Cardinal Structure governs the Church hierarchy. See `systems/npcs/npc_roster_v30.md` for named Cardinals (Prudence, Justice, Gifts, Temperance).

Character Point.definition: Advancement currency earned through Beliefs and session milestones. **CP refers to Character Points only** (ED-136); see PART TWELVE collision entry.

Church Influence.definition: Church political dominance accumulation. Church-specific clock. Per `designs/provincial/ci_political_v30.md` §2.1 (canonical). **Renamed from "Church Influence" (CI) per ED-782.** Old 75 = Phase Transition / Territorial Seizure threshold REMOVED — Mass Seizure now probabilistic from CI ≥ 60.

Co-Movement Card.definition: Strategic-layer mechanism for Thread co-movement; resolved on every Thread operation result. (BG layer — name reflects card-economy origin; engine implementation is automatic on Thread-operation-completion event.)

Cognition.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Coherence.definition: Personal rendering stability for Thread practitioners. Starts at 10. **Coherence is what's broken** in a fractured practitioner.
Coherence.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Combat Endurance.definition: Stamina resource tracking in extended combat. Sub-application of Stamina (Part One); not a separate stat track.

Command.definition: Unit commander stat in mass battle. ⌈(Presence + Cognition) ÷ 2⌉. Caps both Size contribution to pool and Discipline contribution to Health. (PP-232)

Composure.definition: Social endurance (see Part One). Also the damage track in Debate exchanges.

Concentration.definition: Debate resource spent to sustain rhetorical positions.

Conflict Architecture.definition: Architectural specification for conflict resolution across scales. Niflhel dissolution + Löwenritter graduated autonomy + Tensions Deck + Royal Assassination Fuse all anchored here.

DD.definition: DEPRECATED — abbreviation not in active use

Damage Resistance.definition: Armour mitigation value. In mass combat: component of Health per Size formula.

Degree of Success.definition: Outcome tier: Overwhelming / Success / Partial / Failure.

Diagnosis.definition: Mandatory pre-operation read. No roll. Required before Mending, Locking, Dissolution, Past-Oriented Pulling.

Discipline.definition: Unit organisational integrity (replaces Cohesion, PP-232). Contribution to Health per Size capped at Command.

Disposition.definition: NPC-attached attitude state toward another entity (PC, faction, settlement). Drives behaviour-tree branching in NPC AI. Canonical in `systems/npcs/npc_behavior_v30.md`; no separate first-class doc. Heavy cascade-terminal (Mode D — 391 chains).

Dissolution.definition: Forced Resolution; destroys a thread configuration. Requires Thread Sensitivity 50+.

Dissolution Residue.definition: Potency-rated bonus dice source from prior Dissolution. Costs −1 Coherence per use.

Domain Action.definition: Faction-level strategic action resolved at scale-transition phase. Mechanically the unit of strategic-layer decision. Canonical in `systems/_architecture/scale_transitions_v30.md` + `designs/provincial/faction_layer_v30.md`; no separate first-class doc. Heavy cascade-terminal (Mode D — 346 chains).

Domain Echo.definition: Faction-level consequence triggered by decisive Debate outcomes.

Doubt Marker.definition: Applied on Obscuring loss in Diverge state.

Editorial Decision.definition: Editorial decision requiring user approval. Tracked in `canon/editorial_ledger.yaml`.

Einhir.definition: Pre-colonial indigenous culture of the Southernmost territories. Cultural/political axis.

Endurance.definition: Physical resilience. Determines Health and Stamina base.
Endurance.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Expected Value.definition: Probability-weighted average outcome per die or pool. Used in simulation analysis.

FSTAT.definition: DEPRECATED — simulator code, never in-game term

Focus.definition: Attribute governing Thread contact economy — see the Core Attributes table above; do not re-add a formula/range here (this row previously conflated the attribute with a stale derived-stat description).
Focus.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Forced Resolution.definition: Collective term for Locking and Dissolution operations. TN 8. No Thread Pool Score added.

Game Master.definition: Design-source-of-truth role term. **In Valoria's videogame target there is no GM** — engine handles all resolution. The term persists in design corpus as legacy taxonomy; in implementation it maps to engine resolution authority (priority systems, scripted scene resolution, NPC AI orchestration). The bare-`GM` corpus sweep is queued; new content should use "engine" or write "Game Master" in full only when referring to the design-source taxonomic role.

Gap.definition: A rupture in the rendered substrate. Severity scales: Micro-Gap, Standard Gap, Entrenched Gap, Catastrophic Gap.

Genre.definition: Debate argument type selection each exchange.

Grievance Marker.definition: Token placed on a faction after hostile covert action. Originally scoped to Niflhel hostile action; Niflhel-as-faction struck per ED-764, scope extended to any covert/hostile action.

Health.definition: Wound track. Resets per wound. *HP not standalone — write Health.*
Health.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Health per Size.definition: min(Discipline, Command) + DR. Used to derive Total Health and current Size. (PP-233)

History.definition: Skill-equivalent. Specific experiential knowledge that grants bonus dice. Cap = Memory score.

Hybrid.definition: Bridge mode / scale-transition mechanism. Write in full; do not use HYB alone.
Hybrid.glossary_part: PART TEN — GAME MODE LABELS (videogame mechanical layers)

Influence.definition: Social and cultural reach. Cannot drop below 1 (faction remains extant).

Inspiration.definition: Named focus that grants bonus dice when engaged in relevant scenes. Distinct from Belief (which drives Momentum/CP) and History (which is experiential skill). Per ED-779.

Institutional Pressure.definition: Pressure from the Altonian Empire. Invasion threat tracker.

Intelligibility.definition: How legibly reality presents to a fractured practitioner. **Intelligibility is what they perceive of the breakage**. Non-practitioners sense wrongness at threshold.
Intelligibility.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Interaction Type.definition: Determined by Genre + Orientation match between orators.

Knot.definition: A significant relationship bond (Close / Regular / Distant). Mechanically tracked with strain. Lifecycle specified per ED-773.

Leap.definition: Entering Thread contact. Prerequisite for all Thread operations. Full-round action (Priority 5).

Locked Zone.definition: Territory or object subjected to Forced Resolution Lock.

Locking.definition: Forced Resolution; stabilises a thread configuration permanently. Requires Thread Sensitivity 50+.

Mandate.definition: Institutional authority and political legitimacy. 0 = Collapse state.

Mending.definition: Substrate repair. Targets Gaps and Shifting Objects. Requires Thread Sensitivity 50+.

Mending Stability.definition: World coherence. Shared track. Degrades from Thread operations and seasonal effects. **Renamed from Rendering Stability (RS) per ED-731.**

Momentum.definition: Tactical resource. Gained on Overwhelming success or Belief achieved. Spent for automatic successes (non-Thread only).
Momentum.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Monstrous Incursion.definition: Entity manifestation triggered by low Mending Stability or severe Dissolution failure.

Non-Player Character.definition: A character not controlled by the player. In implementation: AI-driven entity with behaviour-tree decision logic per `systems/npcs/npc_behavior_v30.md`.

Obstacle.definition: **Exception — abbreviation permitted standalone.** The number of net successes required for a Success result.

Overweaving.definition: Penalty state from multiple operations on same configuration in one contact window. +1 Ob per op after first.

Overwhelming.definition: Net successes ≥ 2× Ob AND ≥ 3 minimum (TTRPG, PP-232); ≥ Ob + 1 (BG, provisional).

Past-Oriented Pulling.definition: Pulling operation targeting historical thread configurations. Requires Thread Sensitivity 70+.

Patch.definition: Mechanical patch identifier. PP = patch prefix; NNN = sequential number.

Piety Track.definition: Debate position tracker. Side A wins at ≥ 7; Side B wins at ≤ 3. Compromise zone: 4–6. Canonical doc: `systems/characters/conviction_track_v1.md` (promoted PP-681). ⚠ NAMING: `systems/social_contest/social_contest_v30.md` calls this same debate tracker **Persuasion Track** — unresolved glossary↔social-contest name collision (also tangles with the ED-IN-0075 character-Piety→Truth rename); flagged for reconciliation.

Player Character.definition: A character controlled by a player.

Power.definition: Unit offensive quality (replaces Combat Power, PP-232/PP-233). Damage per success = 1 + Power. Derived from unit type.

Presence.definition: Social force and rhetorical gravity. Debate pool base.
Presence.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Public Instability.definition: Parliamentary health tracker. Board Game mode only.

Pulling.definition: Things Open. De-actualises threads. **Default sense is Present-Oriented**; see also Past-Oriented Pulling.

RS.definition: Use Mending Stability (MS). RS appears only as historical annotation in `canon/02_foundations_amendment_leap_mechanism.md` per intentional retention.

Shifting Object.definition: Pre-Gap substrate instability. Less severe than a Gap; addressable by Mending.

Simulation Debt.definition: Outstanding simulation recalibration needed after a mechanical change.

Simulation Identifier.definition: ID format for simulation test outputs. E.g. SIM-D-01, SIM-X-08.

Size.definition: Unit headcount stat (replaces Strength). At 0: unit destroyed. Pool contribution capped at Command. (PP-232)

Spirit.definition: Internal coherence, resolve, and Thread operation capacity.
Spirit.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Stamina.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Standing.definition: Reputation track. Range 0–10 (exception to 1–7 scale). No in-game benefit above 7; 10 is cosmetic maximum.

Strength.definition: Raw physical power. Weapon minimum requirement.
Strength.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

TD.definition: Thread Depth is a phantom stat (REMOVED PP-166). `flowchart TD` is valid Mermaid syntax — not a game term.

Tabletop Roleplaying Game.definition: **Exception — abbreviation permitted standalone.** Personal-scale resolution layer of the Valoria videogame. Source-of-truth name retained from multi-mode origin.
Tabletop Roleplaying Game.glossary_part: PART TEN — GAME MODE LABELS (videogame mechanical layers)

Target Number.definition: **Exception — abbreviation permitted standalone.** The die face threshold for a success (6, 7, or 8 depending on context).

The Rupture.definition: Campaign-ending event when Mending Stability reaches 0.

Thread Depth.definition: Former stat; phantom definition from prior design iteration. Not tracked. Not used.
Thread Depth.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Thread Pool Score.definition: Bonus dice added to Thread operation pools.
Thread Pool Score.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Thread Sensitivity.definition: Perception depth and operation eligibility. Determines accessible operation scale.
Thread Sensitivity.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Thread Tension.definition: Accumulated stress on the rendered world from Thread activity. Faction and world-scale tracker. **TT and Mending Stability run in opposite directions on the same world-state axis** — TT accumulates stress, MS measures coherence remaining.
Thread Tension.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Total Health.definition: Size × H. Full Size always used regardless of Command cap. (PP-233)

Truth.definition: Per-character metaphysical stance (**formerly "Certainty"**; also consolidates the retired character "Piety Track" / religious-standing meter, ED-IN-0075). Solmund orthodoxy (5, *Himmelenger pole*) → Thread-truth acceptance (0, *Edeyja pole*). Engine-internal 0–5; **players see qualitative bands, never the number**. All PCs have it; named NPCs at GM discretion; factions do not hold Truth. *Legacy "Certainty"/`CERT` resolve to Truth pending the corpus rename (ED-IN-0075 staged sweep).*
Truth.glossary_part: PART ONE — GAME STATS AND ATTRIBUTES

Turmoil.definition: Cross-cutting world-scale pressure system (T-07 throughline). Multi-graph hub (Mode A — top quintile in cite + mu + pp).

Victory.definition: Win-condition specification across factions. Faction-specific victory paths (Crown / Church / Hafenmark / Varfell / Löwenritter / RM / Guilds).

Wealth.definition: Economic capacity. 0 = cannot Trade or fund Wealth-requiring actions.

Weaving.definition: Things Cohere. Stabilises threads, restores actualisation.

Zoom In.definition: Scale transition from larger (faction/territorial) to smaller (personal/scene) scale. Mechanically implemented as a transition phase during Domain Action resolution. See `systems/_architecture/scale_transitions_v30.md` §4.

Zoom Out.definition: Scale transition from smaller (personal/scene) to larger (faction/territorial) scale. Reverse of Zoom In.
